title: MbB
description: Optimization and QoL modpack for all sorts of use cases :P
body:
_Btw: This ModPack is mostly for me myself and I(and my friends), but feel free to use it._

Minecraft but Better (MbB) is a fully client-sided ModPack that focuses on having a silky smooth experience for your daily minecraft deeds. PvP, SMP, Redstone, you name it! MbB (probably) has your back.


**WARNING!**
This ModPack is (obviously) only tested on the systems I have access to, so I DO NOT GUARANTEE THAT THIS MODPACK WILL WORK FOR EVERYONE.

I use Arch, btw... so it's technically Linux tested and aprooved! :D

I do not guarantee that this project is gonna recieve LTS, it is just meant for me after all, but if I recieve enough support I just might... or not... idk.
